integrity: The stated theorem is supported by an analytic proof, with independent finite diagnostic programs included. No authorship or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: For even N only an explicit lower bound on worst-case entrance time is proved, not a global upper bound or an all-state census. Possible historical priority overlap with ordinary local cyclic-majority erosion is disclosed.
title: Parity and long transients in majority dynamics on cycle complements
